# Decouple Runner from Concrete UI Types

## Context

`src/runner/workflow.rs` directly imports and uses `BivvyTheme` (concrete theme) and `live_output_callback` (concrete spinner function), and the `SpinnerHandle` trait leaks `indicatif::ProgressBar` through its `progress_bar()` method. This means the runner module depends on presentation implementation details instead of only the `UserInterface`/`SpinnerHandle` trait abstractions.

## Files to Modify

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/ui/mod.rs` | Add 3 methods to `UserInterface` trait; replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `SpinnerHandle`; remove `indicatif` import |
| `src/ui/terminal.rs` | Override new `UserInterface` methods using `self.theme` |
| `src/ui/spinner.rs` | Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `ProgressSpinner`; update 2 tests |
| `src/ui/non_interactive.rs` | Add `output_mode` to `NoopSpinner`; implement `create_output_callback` for verbose streaming |
| `src/runner/workflow.rs` | Use new trait methods; remove `BivvyTheme`/`live_output_callback` imports |

## Step 1: Add formatting methods to `UserInterface` trait

Add three default methods to `UserInterface` in `src/ui/mod.rs`:

- `format_step_header(index, total, name, title) -> String` — plain `"[1/7] name — title"`
- `format_skipped(msg) -> String` — plain `"○ {msg}"`
- `format_status(status: StatusKind, msg) -> String` — delegates to `StatusKind::format_plain(msg)`

## Step 2: Override in `TerminalUI`

In `src/ui/terminal.rs`, override all three methods to use `self.theme` for colored output (matching what `workflow.rs` currently does inline).

## Step 3: Update `workflow.rs` to use trait formatting

Replace all `BivvyTheme` usage in `run_with_ui`:
- `theme.format_skipped(...)` → `ui.format_skipped(...)`
- `StatusKind::X.format(&theme, ...)` → `ui.format_status(StatusKind::X, ...)`
- The step display formatting block → `ui.format_step_header(...)`
- Remove `let theme = BivvyTheme::new();` and `use crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme`

## Step 4: Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `SpinnerHandle`

In `src/ui/mod.rs`:
- Remove `use indicatif::ProgressBar`
- Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback(base_message, indent, max_lines) -> Option<OutputCallback>` (default: `None`)

In `src/ui/spinner.rs`:
- `ProgressSpinner` implements it by calling `live_output_callback(self.bar.clone(), ...)`
- Remove old `progress_bar()` trait impl
- Update 2 tests that tested `progress_bar()`

In `src/ui/non_interactive.rs`:
- Add `output_mode: OutputMode` field to `NoopSpinner`
- Implement `create_output_callback` to return the verbose `println!` callback when mode is `Verbose`

## Step 5: Update `workflow.rs` output callback logic

Replace the `spinner.progress_bar().and_then(...)` + `.or_else(...)` block with:
```rust
let max_lines = match ui.output_mode() { Verbose => 3, Normal => 2, _ => 0 };
let output_callback = if max_lines > 0 {
    spinner.create_output_callback(attempt_label.clone(), 6, max_lines)
} else { None };
```
Remove `use crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback`.

## Verification

- `cargo check` — no warnings for unused imports
- `cargo test` — all existing tests pass
- Confirm `src/runner/workflow.rs` has zero imports from `crate::ui::spinner` or `crate::ui::theme`
- Confirm `SpinnerHandle` trait has no `indicatif` types in its signatures
